definitions.explanation: Medicine used to reduce fever, typically containing ingredients like acetaminophen or ibuprofen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{解熱剤|げねつざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I had a fever so I took fever reducer.

examples.japanese: {子供用|こどもよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{解熱剤|げねつざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you have fever reducer for children?

examples.japanese: {解熱剤|げねつざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧、⟦{数時間|すうじかん}→数時間：21622_suujikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: After taking the fever reducer, my fever went down within a few hours.

notes:
{解熱剤|げねつざい} is medicine specifically for reducing fever. A practical word to know for pharmacy visits and doctor consultations.

FORMS:
⟦{解熱|げねつ}→解熱：23429_genetsu⟧ (fever reduction) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (medicine/agent)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {解熱剤|げねつざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to take fever reducer)
- {解熱剤|げねつざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ (to lower fever with antipyretic)

- アセトアミノフェン (acetaminophen)
- イブプロフェン (ibuprofen)
